Discharge Summary

Admission date/time: 20:22 on 05/03/2020
Discharge date/time: 16:03 on 22/03/2020

Diagnosis: COVID-19 pneumonia, confirmed by SARS-CoV-2 PCR (swab taken 17:12 on 05/03/2020), positive result reported 18:46 on 05/03/2020).

Presenting complaint: Fever, cough and breathlessness with hypoxia (SpO2 <92% on air at 11:53 on 05/03/2020).

Hospital course: Admitted to the acute medical unit requiring supplemental oxygen up to 4L via nasal cannula in the first week. Enoxaparin thromboprophylaxis commenced on admission, first dose given 22:25 on 05/03/2020, continued until discharge. Remained under ward-level care throughout admission without complication. Inflammatory markers peaked around day 3 then trended down steadily.
Remained under ward-level care throughout admission without complication. Gradual improvement in oxygen requirement allowing weaning to air by day 12. Mobilised with physiotherapy input prior to discharge.

Medications on discharge: Enoxaparin was completed on the ward, not continued on discharge given resolution of immobility risk factors. Paracetamol as required for residual myalgia. No new regular medications started.

Follow-up arrangements: Respiratory clinic review arranged within 2 weeks of discharge to assess ongoing recovery.

GP actions: Please review general recovery at routine appointment, monitor for any new respiratory symptoms, and reinforce self-isolation guidance for household contacts as applicable.
